newsitem.title: USA: Pharmos submits NDA for ophthalmic product.
newsitem.headline: Pharmos submits NDA for ophthalmic product.

text.p: Pharmos said Monday it submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for a novel ophthalmic anti-allergy product.
The NDA is the second to be filed in a line of three ophthalmic products containing loteprednol etabonate, a site-specific steroid developed by Pharmos.

The loteprednol-based product has been evaluated in Phase III clinical trials, in the treatment of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis, the most common form of ocular allergy which effects 10-20 percent of the general population. Bausch & Lomb Pharmaceuticals, Inc. a Tampa, Florida-based subsidiary of Bausch & Lomb Inc will make and market the product in the U.S. and other countries upon marketing clearance.
Upon filing of the NDA, Pharmos will receive a milestone payment from Bausch & Lomb in accordance with the original agreement between the companies.
